'''Snufftalon''' was a big [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] and the [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] of the [[Tan Shilley|Shilley's]] cantina in [[Questal/Legends|Questal]].

Once, a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] got in trouble with him, and this fight brought the attention of some members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]], which were trying to find agent [[Tay Vanis|Tiree]].
